players.name: Jeffers/Basallo
players.summary: Rookie C/DH Samuel Basallo went 1-for-4 with an RBI June 16 at Seattle; continues to split catching duties with Adley Rutschman and DH often.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper reached base with a walk and scored a run June 16 vs Miami; hitting in the middle of the Phillies order.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez was out of the Giants' lineup June 16; remains among the NL contact leaders, hitting around .320 as San Francisco's table-setter.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 2-for-5 with an RBI June 16 at Cincinnati; a second straight multi-hit game amid a quieter stretch.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Rookie Kevin McGonigle went 1-for-3 with a walk June 16 at Houston; he has reached base in 25 straight games — an All-Star-caliber start for Detroit.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: Crow-Armstrong homered again June 16 vs Colorado (1-for-5, 1 RBI, 1 R), a day after hitting for the cycle; up to 14 HR with elite defense and baserunning.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill went 1-for-4 with a double and an RBI June 16 at St. Louis; fully back in the lineup after a one-game rib scare (MRI/CT negative).

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernández remains on the IL (since May 27) with a Grade 1 left hamstring strain; the Dodgers are taking a measured approach to his return.

sources.title: Teoscar Hernández expected to miss 1 month - Yahoo Sports

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams (Mets closer) did not pitch June 16; has settled in after a rough April, stringing together scoreless outings with 10 saves on the year.

sources.title: Mets' Devin Williams finding his groove - MLB.com

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler is between starts after dominating June 15 — 6 scoreless 2-hit innings, 9 K — which lowered his ERA to 2.01, among the NL's best.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans had a mid-June rehab setback (elbow stiffness) and was sent for further testing; on the IL since May 8 with no return timeline.

sources.title: Royals' Ragans has setback in rehab - ESPN

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns is between starts after a historic rookie run — June 15's 5 scoreless innings, 7 K, was his 11th straight start allowing 2 or fewer runs.

sources.title: Chase Burns' dominance among greatest Reds stretches - SI

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi is between starts after winning June 14 at Boston (7 IP, 3 ER); the 36-year-old is healthy following a mid-May side-tightness scare.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan remains in the Dodgers' rotation despite an up-and-down ERA; home runs have been the recurring issue, but he's healthy and between starts.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers tossed 7 scoreless innings (3 H, 3 K) for the win June 16 at Arizona, dropping his ERA to 4.31; now 3-2 with strong peripherals (91 K over 81.1 IP).

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice homered with 2 RBI, 2 runs and 2 walks June 16 vs the White Sox; in a full breakout (~.300, 1.000+ OPS, 13 HR), hitting cleanup amid Aaron Judge's absence.

sources.title: From Ivy League catcher to Yankees' cleanup hitter - ESPN

injuries.name: Teoscar Hernandez
injuries.note: Grade 1 left hamstring strain; on IL since May 27, expected ~1 month out with a cautious return timeline.

source.title: Teoscar Hernández expected to miss 1 month - Yahoo Sports

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: Mid-June rehab setback with elbow stiffness; undergoing further testing, no return timeline. On IL since May 8.

source.title: Royals' Ragans has setback in rehab - ESPN
